# Top G Studios

> Top G Studios is an AI-native digital agency. We build software (IT development), embed elite engineering and design talent inside companies (IT manpower deployment), and run enterprise-grade digital marketing programs across SEO, AEO, GEO, performance marketing and lifecycle. We get businesses cited on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews and Google.

Founded by Sanjay Yellar. Serves US-based teams only. All pricing in USD. Active engagements across all US time zones.

## Three operating arms

- IT Development — Custom web applications (Next.js, React, Vue), mobile apps (React Native, Flutter), e-commerce (Shopify Hydrogen, headless, custom), backend systems (Node, Python, Go), cloud architecture (AWS, GCP, Vercel, Cloudflare), DevOps and observability.
- IT Manpower Deployment — Vetted engineers, designers, product managers, tech leads and engineering managers embedded in client teams. Onshore, nearshore, and offshore models. 3 to 12 month engagements typical.
- Digital Marketing Consulting — Enterprise-scale strategy and execution across SEO, AEO, GEO, performance marketing, content, lifecycle and analytics. Fractional CMO engagements available.

## Specialist services

- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) — Getting brands cited inside ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Grok answers. Passage-level citability optimization, schema engineering, brand mention building, llms.txt implementation.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — Winning visibility inside Google AI Overviews and similar generative search experiences. Entity SEO, Knowledge Graph entry, structured data, topical authority.
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization) — Traditional and programmatic SEO. Technical audits, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), content velocity, link building, digital PR, internal linking architecture.
- Performance Marketing — Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger), Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube), LinkedIn Ads. Server-side tracking, Conversions API, landing page CRO.
- LLM and AI Implementation — Custom RAG systems, internal copilots, customer-facing agents, custom GPTs and Claude Projects, voice agents, fine-tuning, prompt engineering.

## Engagement model

- Sprint engagements start at ₹1.5L (single discipline, 2 to 4 week scope, 1 senior operator)
- Growth program: ₹3.5L per month (embedded pod of 3 to 4 people, multi-discipline)
- Enterprise: custom-scoped, embedded teams of 5 to 15+ people, dedicated PMO, 24/7 global coverage

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is AEO and GEO?
A: AEO is Answer Engine Optimization — getting brands cited inside answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. GEO is Generative Engine Optimization — winning visibility inside Google AI Overviews and similar generative search experiences. Both matter because 70% of B2B decision makers now research vendors inside AI assistants before search engines.

Q: How is IT manpower deployment different from typical staffing?
A: Top G Studios deploys senior engineers, designers and tech leads who have shipped real production systems. Engagements are 3 to 12 months, embedded inside client teams and tooling. Not billing bodies — operators who can lead initiatives.

Q: Where is Top G Studios based?
A: Headquartered in India, operating globally across India, the US, UAE, UK, Singapore and Australia.

Q: How fast can Top G Studios start?
A: Discovery call within 48 hours of inquiry. Kickoff in 7 to 10 days for straightforward engagements. Full build engagements scope in 2 weeks.
